segments.name: equipment sales
segments.description: Sells crypto asset mining machines and outdoor computing containers to customers.
segments.evidence: We sell high-performance crypto asset mining machines and outdoor computing infrastructure containers to our customers.

segments.name: hosting
segments.description: Hosts customers' bitcoin mining machines, including hosting, logistics and maintenance, via third-party datacenter partners.
segments.evidence: We provide bitcoin mining machine hosting service based on cloud-computing, including hosting, logistics, and maintenance service to our customers, through collaboration with third-party datacenter partners.

segments.name: mining pool business
segments.description: Runs the Sai.plus mining pool, distributing mining rewards to participants, mainly its hosting clients.
segments.evidence: We provide mining pool service to our customers using Sai.plus, our mining pool.

segments.name: mining
segments.description: Mines cryptocurrency, primarily bitcoin, for the company's own account in its own or partner datacenters.
segments.evidence: We engage in cryptocurrency mining operation, primarily Bitcoins, for our own account.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for mining machines, containers, hosting and mining pool services; the company also earns bitcoin mining revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business primarily consists of sales of products and mining revenue, which accounted for approximately 69% and 31% of our total revenue, respectively, for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.

changes.text: The Company ceased its mining operations in Mexico in August 2025.
changes.evidence: In August 2025, the Company ceased its mining operations in Mexico.
